title: Accessible Table OCR Check
user: Readers, librarians, and accessibility practitioners converting scanned tables who need to verify that extracted text retains reading order and cell structure before sharing it.
smallest_useful_product: A local PWA that accepts page images/OCR JSON, overlays detected blocks and reading order, lets a user relabel table cells and headers, and exports HTML/CSV plus an issue report.
success_measure: Reviewers can identify scrambled reading-order defects and export an accessible table in under five minutes per page.
constraints: Local processing by default; copyright remains the user's responsibility; semantic HTML exports retain source-page references.
